sensitivity.method: Home-weighted, development-level annualised rates: for each development with a URA homes count, resales in the window x 12 / the months it was resellable in the window (from its first resale, capped at the window; at least 12 months required); then the sum of annualised resales / the sum of homes x 100. Larger developments therefore weigh more. The 12-month headline (4.4) is 643 / 14,559 directly. The windows are sensitivities, not the headline, and are not compared with the Singapore 12-month figure.

reconciliation.explanation: C020141 lists three dwelling categories (HDB dwellings, condominium & other apartments, landed properties). Its Total (column "Total1/") also covers households in dwelling types the table does not list; SingStat's footnote 1/ is not reproduced in the stored record. Each figure is separately rounded to the nearest 100 (SingStat: "may not add up due to rounding"), so rounding accounts for at most 200 of the gap and at least 600 households are in the unlisted category.

insights.text: Hougang has about 59,500 HDB flats and 23,100 private homes: 2.6 HDB flats for every private home.
insights.qualifier: Counts of homes, not of buyers.
insights.period: HDB as at 2026-10-08; URA records to 2026-02-26

insights.text: Hougang condos resell about twice as often as its HDB flats: 4.4 vs 2.1 homes per 100 a year (Singapore 3.5 vs 2.2).
insights.qualifier: Partly lifted by three recently completed developments; 3.7 without them.

insights.text: Hougang ranks joint 2nd of 35 planning areas for condo resale activity. Excluding three recently completed developments, it ranks joint 8th.
insights.qualifier: Resale activity does not establish selling time or price performance. Both rankings are given because three recently completed developments lift Hougang's headline rate.

rank.rule: areas with 1,000+ flats / homes; condo and EC developments with 12+ months since their first resale; HDB by HDB Property Information block positions

rankExcludingRecent.rule: areas with 1,000+ flats / homes; condo and EC developments with 12+ months since their first resale; HDB by HDB Property Information block positions

peerComparisons.note: joint 2nd with Punggol; joint 8th with Serangoon

insights.text: 1,230 HDB flats and 672 condos resold in Hougang in the last 12 months.
insights.qualifier: October 2025 to September 2026. The 672 condo resales are all resales; the resale rate uses the 643 resales in the 50 developments for which URA records the number of homes.

insights.text: Hougang's 5-room flats resold at a median $785,000, 6% above Singapore's $740,000.
insights.qualifier: Median of 239 resales. Shown for context; it does not indicate what any buyer can afford.

insights.text: Half of Hougang households (50.4%) earn $10,000 or more a month from work, in line with Singapore (50.5%).
insights.qualifier: Household income does not measure buying power or demand. Survey estimate from the General Household Survey 2025.

insights.text: Hougang Central (about 830 homes) was awarded in a government land sale in January 2026; its completion date has not been stated.
insights.qualifier: A dated award record; it is not included in any supply figure.
